DemoProblem.title: DemoProblem
DemoProblem.description: Public, read-only illustrative demonstration problem record. Strictly restricted to the three approved demo document IDs.

id.description: Approved demonstration problem identifier matching document ID.

affectedAudience.description: Groups potentially impacted in the illustrative scenario.

recurrenceNote.description: Honest statement noting recurrence is not yet verified.

isIllustrativeDemo.description: Explicit marker separating illustrative records from verified research.

evidenceAvailability.description: Must be 'none' for unverified demonstration documents.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Minimal authenticated Kopi user record storing self-declared 18+ eligibility and timestamped legal consent records without unnecessary PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional sanitized display name (trimmed non-empty <= 120 chars; may be null).

consents.description: Versioned Terms of Service and Privacy Policy acceptance records with timestamps.

SavedOpportunity.title: SavedOpportunity
SavedOpportunity.description: User-owned bookmark linking a user account to an approved demonstration or published opportunity, keyed by problemId.

problemId.description: Approved problem identifier matching the document ID.

savedAt.description: Server-assigned timestamp when the opportunity was saved.

sourceScreen.description: Surface from which the user initiated the bookmark.

PublishedProblem.title: PublishedProblem
PublishedProblem.description: Public, read-only sanitized research problem record approved via founder editorial review and published to /publishedProblems.

id.description: Published problem identifier matching the document ID.

slug.description: URL-safe slug matching the document ID.

affectedAudience.description: Audience segments supported by research observations.

recurrenceNote.description: Honest statement describing observed recurrence and limitations.

isIllustrativeDemo.description: Must be false for published research problems.

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp when founder approved publication.

publicationStatus.description: 'published' when publicly readable or 'archived' when withdrawn from public feed.

independentEvidenceCount.description: Deduplicated count of independent evidence records.

sourceDiversityCount.description: Count of distinct approved sources cited.

evidence.description: Sanitized public evidence references (excludes reviewer notes and PII).

insights.description: Categorized insights distinguishing verified_observation from ai_generated/hypothesis.

existingAlternatives.description: Existing workarounds or alternatives documented in observations.

commercialRelevance.description: 7-dimension qualitative commercial relevance assessment without invented numeric scores.

/demoProblems/{problemId}.description: Public read-only single-document demonstration records for the 3 approved demo IDs. Collection listing and all client writes are denied.

/publishedProblems/{problemId}.description: Public read-only sanitized research records (get and limit<=50 list where publicationStatus == 'published' and isIllustrativeDemo == false; all client writes denied).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document storing self-declared 18+ eligibility and legal consent timestamps without unnecessary PII.

/users/{userId}/savedOpportunities/{prob.description: Owner-only subcollection storing bookmarks keyed by approved demo or published problemId to prevent duplicates.
